selectionRule: Among hybrid arms at lambda 1, maximise macro NDCG@10. An exact tie breaks by preprocessOrder, then templateOrder, then fusionOrder, then alphaOrder. Then take the largest lambda whose macro intra-list diversity gain over lambda 1 is positive and whose macro NDCG@10 loss is at most 0.01. Otherwise lambda stays 1.

lambdaDecision.reason: largest lambda with a diversity gain and NDCG@10 loss at or below the budget

queryDefinition: Each validation image is paired with each validation paraphrase of that image's class. The text query is the prompt template with {} replaced by the paraphrase. Relevance is the shared class.
queryOrder: Images follow the committed split file. Paraphrases follow text-queries.v1.json. A hybrid arm loops images in that order and, within each image, the validation paraphrases of its class in file order.
